development_notes: The first passing-baseline run tested 157 mutants: 127 caught, 24 unviable, five timeouts, one survivor.

The survivor reversed the polling cadence comparison and called the cancellation predicate on nearly every syntax operation. A behavioral extraction test now verifies that predicate calls are amortised across node visits; the final complete run catches it.
limits: Five timeout mutants prevent completed results and leave startup fixtures waiting; timeouts are separate from assertion catches.
Macro-expanded fingerprints, grammar/dependency internals, browser code, source policy, persistence, and OS event delivery are outside this mutation scope.
Only complete successful analyses may warm the disposable cache during a cancelled attempt. Zero survivors is not proof of correctness.
